pr_title: [CI] Cache build artifacts with GitHub Actions-Caches
source_quote: The same workflow should not be repeated; a matrix with different image should be added.

rule.description: 当多个 CI 工作流 job 执行相同的步骤但使用不同的参数（如不同的 Docker image）时，应使用 GitHub Actions 的 matrix 策略来消除重复定义，提高工作流的可维护性。

antipattern.code:
# a matrix with different image should be added."
# 相同的工作流被重复定义，每个 image 一个独立 job

name: Schedule Build vLLM Ascend Cache

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-image-cann-10.0:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: quay.io/ascend/cann:10.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: cann-10.0-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
      - name: Build wheel
        run: pip wheel --no-deps -w dist .

  build-image-cann-11.0:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: quay.io/ascend/cann:11.0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: cann-11.0-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
      - name: Build wheel
        run: pip wheel --no-deps -w dist .
antipattern.context: The same workflow should not be repeated; a matrix with different image should be added.

pattern.code:
# commit 8416caa "Cache build artifacts with GitHub Actions"
# 使用 matrix 策略，不同 image 通过参数区分

name: Schedule Build vLLM Ascend Cache

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - image: quay.io/ascend/cann:10.0
            cache_key: cann-10.0
          - image: quay.io/ascend/cann:11.0
            cache_key: cann-11.0
    container:
      image: ${{ matrix.image }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ matrix.cache_key }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
      - name: Build wheel
        run: pip wheel --no-deps -w dist .
pattern.context: The same workflow should not be repeated; a matrix with different image should be added.
